## Pose photos and generated photos

The pose reference photos in `bench/poses/` and the photos in `bench/runs/mini-test-v0.1/images/` were generated by us with gemini-nano-banana-2.1 on 2026-11-10. The people in them are synthetic adults, not real people. The generated photos start from the CC0 or public-domain product photos above. We dedicate both sets to the public domain under CC0 1.0, to the extent any rights exist. The generation prompt of every pose photo is recorded in `bench/ASSETS.json`.

## Figures

The figures in `docs/img/` are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Their sources are in `docs/img/src/`.

## Trademarks

Product names and logos that are visible in the photos (for example Labello) belong to their owners. They appear only to identify the products that were checked. No endorsement is implied.
